name: touching-time-museum-art-portrait
image_purpose: show a respectful fashion interaction with classical art

prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with dark-brown half-up soft waves, natural warm makeup, cream-beige corset-style top with lace-up ribbon detailing, ivory skirt, small gold earrings, thin bracelet and small chain-strap shoulder bag. She stands in profile and gently touches a modest marble statue cheek/chin with a respectful gesture.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft midday sun beam with gentle shadows and realistic highlights on marble and skin, warm creamy beige palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic cinematic editorial, subtle 35mm grain, natural dynamic range, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and stone texture.
